notes: Three findings the sweep is meant to surface. The export route is the one of four missing require_login, so an unauthenticated caller reads any report as CSV; the decorator is present everywhere else, which is what makes the gap easy to miss. get_report and export_report both load by identifier without checking the caller owns the report, so the substitution test fails. The admin reimburse route carries the same guard as user-facing routes, so any logged-in user creates a payout. Authorization is scattered inline rather than centralized, which is why one route drifted.
